issues.title: Unexpected page title on /
issues.details: Expected title including "Command Center", got "Clinical Operations Center".
issues.suggestion: Ensure each route renders its intended section heading consistently.

issues.title: Unexpected page title on /billing
issues.suggestion: Ensure each route renders its intended section heading consistently.

issues.title: API validation and server failures collapse into a generic error toast
steps: Open Register Patient and submit invalid data such as age -1 or too-short name
issues.details: Validation toast: API Error occurred; API failure toast: API Error occurred
issues.suggestion: Read FastAPI "detail" payloads and distinguish 4xx validation messages from 5xx failures.

issues.title: Form labels are not programmatically associated with their fields
steps: Inspect labels on /login and Register Patient modal with a screen reader or accessibility tree
issues.details: Examples: Username, Password, Full Name, Age, Gender, Blood Group
issues.suggestion: Add unique input ids and connect each label with htmlFor, or wrap the input inside the label.

issues.title: Password visibility toggle is removed from keyboard navigation
issues.details: Focusable control with tabindex=-1: Show password
issues.suggestion: Remove tabindex=-1 so keyboard users can operate the password visibility control.

issues.title: Modal dialog is missing core accessibility semantics
steps: Open Register Patient or any modal
issues.suggestion: Add role="dialog", aria-modal="true", a labelled title, focus management, and Escape handling.
